confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are triangulated from several secondary, partly undated guides (some Numbeo-derived, some crowdsourced) that disagree, so treat them as bounded estimates. Beer, cocktail and wine-by-the-glass are the least certain drink anchors; the cocktail and wine figures rest on a few anecdotes and a bar-price benchmark, cross-checked against the local beer-to-wine relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July 2026 peak season from general knowledge and the Essaouira context, not checked against live booking pages or current listings. The FX observation was taken from a search snippet of the RBA exchange-rates page, not from an opened RBA data file.
comparable_city_reasoning: Essaouira is a mid-sized Moroccan coastal tourist town. Food and drink are priced as a Moroccan coastal resort: a comparison site puts restaurants about 7.5% below the Morocco average, and bar and cafe prices sit between Moroccan budget towns and Marrakech's tourist core. Accommodation is benchmarked to mid-sized Moroccan coastal resorts with July peak-season uplift. Region is set to Africa.
